data.name: Andris
data.long_meaning: Andris is a Greek name with the meaning 'man' or 'warrior'. It is derived from the Greek word 'andros', which means 'man'. In ancient Greek culture, the name Andris was given to boys who were expected to grow up to be strong and courageous men.
